title: #067. Supplier Allocation with Semi-Continuous & Share Caps
subtitle: Allocate plant procurement across suppliers under semi-continuous order bounds, single-supplier share caps, and active vendor limits.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { active, allocations, totalCost }.
judge.m1: Field "allocations" must have {p0} rows (one per supplier).
judge.m5: Supplier {p0} total order ({p1}) must lie in [{p2}, {p3}] for its activation status.
judge.m6: Active supplier count ({p0}) must lie within [{p1}, {p2}].
judge.m8: Reported totalCost ({p0}) does not match recomputed cost ({p1}).
judge.m9: Valid procurement plan, but totalCost ({p0}) exceeds minimum ({p1}).
